title: SodaPhantom's Custom Records Vol 1
description: Replaces existing music discs in Minecraft with new original music made by me! This is volume 1, which includes the first 5 original song replacements, out of the 21 discs as of writing this!
body:
My first resource pack! This resource pack replaces some of the original music discs in Minecraft with original tracks made by Me (SodaPhantom)! This is part 1, which I call volume 1, of this resource pack. It includes 5 out of 21 tracks that are replaced (at the time of writing this). 

Music will be uploaded to my YouTube channel, "SodaPhantom"

Please comment on here or on YouTube if there are any issues you encounter!
